resources.string: Normally your phone drops your home Wi-Fi as soon as it connects to the camera. OsmoLink can switch that off so both connections stay up at the same time, and your internet keeps working while you browse and download.
✓ On. Your home Wi-Fi stays connected while the camera is connected.
Your phone cannot hold two Wi-Fi connections at once. OsmoLink still works, but your home Wi-Fi will disconnect while the camera is connected.
This needs Android 11 or newer. OsmoLink still works, but your home Wi-Fi will disconnect while the camera is connected.
Currently off (for example after a restart). It switches itself back on as soon as your phone is on Wi-Fi.

Open Settings › About phone › Software information and tap \"Build number\" 7 times. Enter your PIN if asked. Then come back here.
Your phone needs to be on a Wi-Fi network, for example your home Wi-Fi.

Tap \"Start\". In the screen that opens: 1) Switch on \"Wireless debugging\" and tap \"Allow\". 2) Tap the words \"Wireless debugging\" themselves, then \"Pair device with pairing code\". 3) Pull down the notification shade. On the OsmoLink notification tap the small arrow, then \"Enter code\", type the 6 digits and send. OsmoLink does the rest.
⏳ Waiting for \"Pair device with pairing code\"…
👉 Found. Now enter the 6-digit code in the OsmoLink notification.
✗ Code wrong or expired. Open \"Pair device with pairing code\" again and enter the new code.
